description: Writes a message without sending it, for a human to read and send — use it when you are asked to prepare replies for sign-off. It is filed in the address’s `drafts` folder and opens in the web inbox, where a person edits and sends it; there is no tool here that sends it. **To answer a message, pass its id as `in_reply_to` and its sender as `to`**: unlike `reply_to_message`, a draft reads no recipients off the message. It is sent as a reply to it, and with `subject` left off it takes “Re: ” and the original’s.
name: create_draft
title: Write a reply for a person to send
